policy: Property names in ui-controls.json map to coverage.json by their final path component; nested group controls map to the group's children. The remaining controls below are UI state, getters or actions rather than additional stored task properties.

groups.document: cloze.value; compound content is in content-presets.json
groups.idList: connected drop lists; UI-generated drag tasks contain real linked identifiers
groups.alias: Unique variable alias; edited through the real UI in the round-trip tests
groups.type: Input-assistance control type; stored as inputAssistancePreset

editorOnly.css: Editor stylesheet loading and rich-text editor CSS configuration
